items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 150:1
items.html: This world is divided into BYA and the place of the Klipot, for the place of the Temple is its Beriah, the Land of Israel is its Yetzirah, and outside the Land is its Assiyah. And the desert is the place of the Klipot. (Item 44).
